content.value: List the necessary assumptions of the Bernoulli distribution. An automatic traffic control (10) [CO1] system monitors video download speeds for under-speeding. Based on a previous analysis, the probability of a video being under-speeded is 0. 10. In à specific time-frame, four videos are investigated. Calculate the probability for the following scenarios:
i) Green light: No under-speeded video observed.
ii) Red light: All videos are under-speeded.
iii) Yellow light: At least one, but not all videos are under-speeded.
